summary: Chat citations don't render live (only after refresh): parser too strict for real model CITATIONS formats
description:
Regression from todo:50b9a90a (strip CITATIONS tail from chat, render styled cards from parseCitationsBlock).

SYMPTOM: chat citation cards do not appear during the live stream; they only show after a page refresh.

ROOT CAUSE: live path renders cards from parseCitationsBlock(streamed text); refresh path rehydrates from chunks_used -> corpus.chunks (authoritative). The parser only accepted the documented '[tradition | text | section | TIER: x]' line ending exactly in ']'. Real model output (confirmed from queries rows) uses two other shapes:
  1. bracketed + inline quote on same line: [a | b | c | tier: x] "quote..."  (line doesn't end in ']')
  2. index-prefixed, unbracketed fields echoing the SOURCE PASSAGES input shape: [7] neoplatonism | b | c | Tier: verified
Both yielded zero parsed citations -> no live cards. Refresh path bypasses the parser, hence 'only after refresh'.

FIX: added extractFields() in src/lib/citations.ts tolerating both formats (+ leading tier glyph, inline-quote preference). Strict documented format still parses identically.

TESTS: 3 regression tests added to src/__tests__/citations.test.ts; full suite 530 passed, typecheck clean.
